notes.content:
*Players now spawn on bridge and have the option to choose their path now that both citys can be accessed.
 *Created 5 new safe houses with respawn and save slots.( just head over to bed and computer and to interact with.
 *Added Warehouse storage. Items found around the map can be stored in players warehouse 
* Ai can now attack from distance.
 * jerry can (fuel can) can now be use to store water or gas.
 * Updated muti-play.
 *New explorable buildings/locations (Medicenter, self storage center, Park, Docks to catch fish, 1 apartment building & 3 new Houses.
* More ways to earn money.
                                                               (More Content Coming)

compass now shows non discover areas as questions marks (New way to gain xp and now Can be gained from exploring new areas/islands)
